text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Whew! That wraps up today's training menu, huh.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… Just as expected, suitable 
incline. Athletic park nearby too…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo, Ikuno. What're you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Stego, good work today. Other day, 
I found excellent training spot.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Long, unpaved incline gentle on legs. 
Hill riddled with stairs and bare dirt… 
View is fine too, making it optimal.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I planned to head over now, so 
I was merely confirming route.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that kind of place…! Sounds real 
fun! Mind if I tag along?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Certainly, I do not mind. Having 
companion makes trip reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, only on condition you are 
not fatigued. How is your condition?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Not tired at all, right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: No worries, I'll see you later!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's head out. Looking forward 
to this! If it's your plan, it'll be solid.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. Now then, 
let us begin our training!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That will not do. You must prioritize 
your physical health first.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Can't argue with that. Guess I'll take 
it easy today. Guide me next time, yeah?
